Obama care needs to be converted into personal health savings accounts that the government can put money into for people like this young lady. That way they can contribute their own money to an HSA account if they’d like, and then they can use their buying power to choose which insurance company they want.

That’s the way it works for 180 million people in the private sector, and it can work that way also for the 24 million people that work in the private sector and use ACA coverage, the Obama care scam.

For those people that work for small companies that don’t provide healthcare insurance, the government can subsidize healthcare insurance for them. Just like I pay a weekly payroll deduction for my private company sponsored health insurance, this young lady should be able to do the same thing, with a payroll deduction that goes directly into her health savings account (HSA).  

Qualifying small businesses should be able to receive $1 for $1 match for every individual contributing to an HSA account. Where the government matches every dollar they contribute for a dollar from the money that would’ve been going to the insurance companies.  Individuals can then use a VISA/MC card linked to their HSA account when they go to see their provider. Not having to worry about having cash on hand in an emergency when a child has a fever or something worse.

She can pick what insurance company she wants. Know what her maximum out-of-pocket is every year, and know what her deductible/co-pay is.
So she will know what it’s going to cost when she goes to the doctor. And she will know in a worst case scenario how much it will cost her yearly for her family and her. 

Individuals being able to select their own insurance drives competition in the market. Just like in the private sector, and with Medicare recipients when choosing medicare advantage plans.

Obama care is a complete disaster. It was designed to enrich the insurance companies, and in return they pad the wallets of the Democrat politicians. The Democrats don’t want this to stop. They want it to continue because that’s how they get rich.
